blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Mission total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Hemlock fell from 12 in June to 9 in September, and 1 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 7.4% of Mission’s 122 condos and townhomes listed.
